title: Trinity and the Holy Spirit
definition: Trinity and the Holy Spirit teaches that the Holy Spirit is the third Person of the triune God, distinct from the Father and the Son, yet fully God.
summary: The Spirit is included with the Father and Son in baptism, blessing, redemption, and the life of the Church. He shares in the one divine work of God.
christFocus: The Spirit applies the redemption accomplished by Christ and brings believers into fellowship with the Father through the Son.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit is included with the Father and Son in baptism, blessing, redemption, and the life of the Church. He shares in the one divine work of God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
